news.title: Kylian Mbappe labelled 'childish and pathetic' by France World Cup winner over Ballon d'Or claim
news.lede: Real Madrid star Mbappe thinks this 'might be a good year' for him to win the award for the first time. Talking up his chances ahead of Madrid's Champions League opener against Inter Milan, the France captain – who broke the all-time World Cup goals record this summer – said: "I think when you play for Real Madrid, the best club in the world, people associate you with this award [the Ballon d'Or]. "There are many people that speak about me and the Ballon d'Or. Of course I've made history in the most important competition.

news.title: Philippines women’s national football team secures qualification for 2027 FIFA Women’s World Cup
news.lede: News On AIR | March 19, 2026 1:13 PM. The Philippines women’s national football team have secured qualification for the 2027 FIFA Women’s World Cup after defeating the Uzbekistan women’s national football team 2-0 in a Women’s Asian Cup play-in match on the Gold Coast today. Angela Beard delivered a standout performance, opening the scoring early in the second half after earlier missed opportunities. She found the net in the 47th minute with a well-taken strike into the roof of the goal.

news.title: Masr! What the World Cup Taught Me About Being Egyptian
news.lede: (“Left, right, we are Egyptians!”) a group of Egyptian fans chant outside Seattle’s iconic Pier 58 stadium. I joined the thousands dressed in red-black-and-white marching from the Central Waterfront to Lumen Field. We were going to war, but it wasn’t a military campaign.

news.title: Can Kane buck history and win Ballon d'Or?
news.lede: Harry Kane helped England to third place in the World Cup. With the Ballon d'Or shortlist to be announced on Tuesday, Harry Kane heads the field as the bookmakers' favourite after a prolific season for club and country. History, however, suggests football's biggest individual prize is rarely decided on goals alone. Since the Ballon d'Or was first awarded in 1956, performances in the game's biggest competitions have consistently shaped the outcome.
